code:
use default

let sequence =
    "CGTAAAAAATTACAACGTCCTTTGGCTATCTCTTAAACTCCTGCTAAATG"
    "CTCGTGCTTTCCAATTATGTAAGCGTTCCGAGACGGGGTGGTCGATTCTG"
    "AGGACAAAGGTCAAGATGGAGCGCATCGAACGCAATAAGGATCATTTGAT"
    "GGGACGTTTCGTCGACAAAGTCTTGTTTCGAGAGTAACGGCTACCGTCTT"
    "CGATTCTGCTTATAACACTATGTTCTTATGAAATGGATGTTCTGAGTTGG"
    "TCAGTCCCAATGTGCGGGGTTTCTTTTAGTACGTCGGGAGTGGTATTATA"
    "TTTAATTTTTCTATATAGCGATCTGTATTTAAGCAATTCATTTAGGTTAT"
    "CGCCGCGATGCTCGGTTCGGACCGCCAAGCATCTGGCTCCACTGCTAGTG"
    "TCCTAAATTTGAATGGCAAACACAAATAAGATTTAGCAATTCGTGTAGAC"
    "GACCGGGGACTTGCATGATGGGAGCAGCTTTGTTAAACTACGAACGTAAT"

let width = 50

let counts = MAP[char, int]()

for base in "ACGT" do
    counts[base] = 0
od

for base in sequence do
    counts[base] = counts[base] + 1
od

for start in 0..sequence.length / width do
    let line = sequence.substring(start * width, width)

    write_line("{start * width + 1,5}: {line}")
od

write_line("")

for base in "ACGT" do
    write_line("{base}: {counts[base],5}")
od

write_line("")
write_line("total: {sequence.length,5}")
